hooks.name: Check new assets are listed in ASSETS.md
hooks.description: When a file is created under web/public, remind the agent that the Kiroween rules require every third-party asset to have a source and license entry in ASSETS.md before it is committed.

action.prompt: A file was added under web/public. Before committing, add it to ASSETS.md with its source URL and license (CC0 or a license that allows this use). If you made it yourself in code, say so. Kiroween rules: no third-party trademarks or copyrighted material without permission.
